doc: Whole-island visual parity viewpoints (plan P5), one or more per world row W00-W20 plus the sea views of W00. Generated by tools/parity/make_island_poses.py from committed world data: rerun it, do not edit. Unreal units as poses.json: location in cm (x east, y south, z up), rotation in degrees, fov horizontal. Pose names are <wrow>_<what>; capture with --only to select a row (fnmatch globs, e.g. w07_*).
